d: Jeremy and Jazzy is a musical adventure series where there's a story in every song!
Hopper and Big Boo end up exchanging their respective colours... and personalities. / Sunny Bunnies try to be painters for one day. The task becomes easier when Hopper discovers a magic brush.
Sunny Bunnies will use all possible means to jump over the bar. / Even though balls and rings keep falling down, Sunny Bunnies will not give up until becoming professional jugglers.
Sunny Bunnies got trapped inside a TV screen when using a magic selfie camera. / Sunny Bunnies will help Big Boo to fulfill his dream: being a pilot.
While performing as a magician for his friends, Big Boo makes them all disappear. What will he do to bring them back? / An Indian magician arrived at the circus.
Sunny Bunnies will not give up until they get a ride on their favourite merry-go-round. / Sunny Bunnies will learn how to use a magic wand and that laughing is the remedy for any spell.

Sunny Bunnies' fun nature is impossible to put on hold, and a symphonic concert turns into a mischievous disco. / Ready, steady, go! Sunny Bunnies appear on athletics stadium to have their own sprint.
Solar eclipse interrupts Sunny Bunny's play. To solve the mystery, they urgently set off for the Moon. / While inspectioning the props left at the circus, Hopper ends up inside the magician's case.

Museums are always full of interesting stuff and secret passages! Just the perfect place for Sunny Bunnies to play hide and seek / Sunny Bunnies inflate too many balloons and Shiny ends up in the sky.
Sunny Bunnies are not very good at sharing yummy ice cream. And the magic doors make their ice cream chase even more eventful! / Sunny Bunnies will experiment the static electricity's effect on their
Sunny Bunnies will have to agree on what to do when there is only one coin and multiple options to spend it / It's Christmas time and  Sunny Bunnies  decorate a Christmas tree.

A cursed helmet turns Big Boo into an angry and pugnacious knight. / Sunny Bunnies discover a magic flower which makes wishes come true, but Hopper will soon realize playing alone is not that much fun
Turbo volunteers to be the referee while the other Sunny Bunnies learn to play tennis. But he will soon regret his decision. / Big Boo seems to be allergic to bubbles.
